description: Turn '1.234,56', '١٬٢٣٤٫٥٦', '12 345,6' or '1,234.56' into an exact decimal, using the locale's separators first and a clearly flagged heuristic when they do not match. Example: text '1.234,56', locale 'de'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[]; deterministic (no AI inside), nothing logged.

locale.description: Locale whose separators to assume first; a heuristic fallback handles mismatches and says so.
locale.title: Locale

title: Read a human-written number
